scope: supervised transfer for one compact pretrained instruction model on a simulated compliance contract; no claim of live dispatch or executable-control improvement

protocol.pair_probe: up to 32 exact-request state-change pairs and 32 exact-context request-variant pairs, one pair per group, sampled from the strict test partition before inference
protocol.adaptation: LoRA query and value projections, rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05; frozen pretrained weights
protocol.checkpoint_selection: highest validation macro-F1, then lowest validation target-token loss
protocol.prediction: maximum summed conditional log probability of a complete canonical label and end token
protocol.primary_metric: macro-F1 on the same label-balanced held-out sample before and after training
protocol.additional_metrics: accuracy, per-label F1, both-correct state pairs, exact-context request variants, instruction-only ablation
protocol.inference_policy: identical candidate labels, prompt template, tokenizer, and inference rule before and after tuning
protocol.scope: supervised transfer for one compact pretrained instruction model on a simulated compliance contract; no claim of live dispatch or executable-control improvement
protocol.resource_policy: local MPS or CPU; at most 8 CPU threads; retain small adapter checkpoints only

target_provenance: released synthetic compliance-contract labels; no prediction-derived reference
bootstrap_policy: 1000 paired resamples of entire scenario clusters within the fixed label-balanced test sample; seeds remain separate

request_variant_protocol.purpose: same-state request-variant diagnostic, added after the source-partition audit found no exact-context request pairs
request_variant_protocol.selection: 32 unique strict-test scenarios, round-robin across canonical labels, selection seed 20261001
request_variant_protocol.targets: unchanged synthetic compliance-contract labels from canonical strict-test records; no prediction-derived references
instructions: Assess the proposed dispatch action using the supplied operating context and return its compliance classification.
For this operating state and proposed action, identify whether the applicable requirements are satisfied, including any monitoring condition.
request_variant_protocol.held_constant: complete input object, proposed action, operating state, operator goal, and reference label
request_variant_protocol.models: same pinned base model and the three saved adapters; no additional training or checkpoint selection
request_variant_protocol.metrics: label agreement and both predictions correct on 32 pairs
request_variant_protocol.scope: controlled request rendering for the compliance contract; no claim of unrestricted dispatcher-language equivalence

sample_provenance_scope: selected training and validation records versus primary test and controlled request-probe source records
